subject: Post-call: NextWave AI — pilot proposal & timeline (usage + expansion path)
messages:
From: Alex Turner <alex.turner@nextwave.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Elise Chung <elise.chung@nextwave.ai>
Date: Fri, 24 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up from today's call — usage and priorities

Thanks for the call this morning, Karthik. Quick summary from our side so we're aligned before your follow-ups: 

- Current environment: 2M daily API requests (mostly chat completions), spiky patterns with two weekly peaks (support hours) and a large nightly batch for indexing/search.
- Primary pain: token cost and latency for real-time chat — customer experience drops when we hit spikes.
- Secondary pain: embedding generation for nightly index is expensive and slow; ops team wants better parallelism and caching.
- Compliance: some EU customers require data locality (we need an EU hosting option or assurances).

What we'd like from Redwood: 
1) A concrete pilot plan that shows cost/latency improvements and a path to Dedicated or Private deployment.
2) An estimate of what committed capacity (and cost) would look like for 150M tokens/day steady-state and expected peak factor (x3).
3) Benchmarks or a short workload test for our RAG embeddings pipeline.

Appreciate you looping in your SE and CS partners. Elise and I are available next week for a follow-up to review a written pilot proposal.

— Alex

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@nextwave.ai>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 24 Apr 2027 12:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up from today's call — usage and priorities

Alex — thanks for the clear summary. Putting one in writing from the Redwood side and capturing owners / timing so we have a tight plan: 

Summary of what we heard (confirm if anything missing):
- Goal: reduce per-token cost by ~30% while meeting sub-200ms median p95 for chat during peaks; provide a scalable embedding pipeline to cut nightly index time in half.
- Constraints: some EU data locality requirements for a subset of customers; SLA target 99.95% for user-facing endpoints.
- Current sizing ask: qualification for ~150M tokens/day with peak factor ~3.

Proposed pilot (owners and timeline):
- 4-week technical benchmark (Jordan lead) — sample workload run on Redwood Dedicated test capacity: chat + batched embeddings (deliverables: latency and cost delta, error / failure modes). Target start: 2027-05-04.
- 8-week pilot/POC (Marissa lead + Karthik) — reserved capacity window in our Dedicated pool, onboarding playbook, and telemetry in Redwood Console; includes prefix/KV caching enabled, quantization recommendations from Priyom.
- Outcome: decision review with NextWave engineering + product to move to Reserved capacity (monthly commit) or Private (VPC) for EU-sensitive traffic.

Action items and owners:
- Karthik: send pilot proposal + high-level pricing for 1) benchmark-only, 2) 3-month reserved pilot, 3) 12-month commit. (By 2027-04-28)
- Jordan: capture sample workload instructions and runbook; need NextWave test keys and a 48-hour sample window. (Plan by 2027-04-30)
- Marissa: propose onboarding timeline and a CSM handoff plan for pilot. (Draft by 2027-05-02)
- Priyom: provide quantization/embedding recommendations and expected cost delta for our recommended config. (Initial notes by 2027-04-29)

I've attached a one-page pilot outline and an estimated-usage CSV to help with sizing. Jordan — see the specific items below we need from NextWave to spin up the sample: 
- A representative batch of 200K chat messages (anonymized) or a synthetic generator that mirrors your token distribution.
- Example embedding requests and a sample index snippet.
- Any compliance sys-ops checklist for EU-hosted workload.

Next steps: Alex, Elise — can you confirm availability for a proposal review on 2027-04-28 (30 minutes)? If that works we'll circulate the pilot PDF ahead of the call.

Best,
Karthik
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0104

Attachments: nextwave-pilot-proposal.pdf, estimated-usage-2027-q2.csv

From: Alex Turner <alex.turner@nextwave.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Elise Chung <elise.chung@nextwave.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 28 Apr 2027 13:01:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up from today's call — usage and priorities

Thanks — 2027-04-28 at 10:00 PT works for Elise and me. A couple of clarifying Qs ahead of the pilot review: 

1) For the benchmark, can you include (a) expected delta on token cost vs our current provider, and (b) a rough estimate of reserved capacity sizing for a 3x peak?
2) For EU-sensitive customers, would the pilot cover an EU-hosted Private deployment test or only Dedicated in our chosen region? We need to know the path for data locality compliance.

We'll get the anonymized sample chat payload over to Jordan by EOD tomorrow. Also looping in Samuel (ops) if there are infra-specific items we need to track.

— Alex

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@nextwave.ai>
Cc: Elise Chung <elise.chung@nextwave.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 28 Apr 2027 15:06:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up from today's call — usage and priorities

Appreciate the quick confirmation. Short answers and what we'll deliver on the 30-minute review (2027-04-28 10:00 PT):

1) Cost delta: the pilot PDF includes modeled savings for our recommended config (continuous batching + prefix caching + int8 quantized variant) — preliminary expectation: 20–35% unit cost reduction depending on model/quantization choice. We'll show a side-by-side table vs your current per-token bill.
2) EU path: initial benchmark will run in our US Dedicated test pool to show delta. If the results meet the threshold you'll be able to transition EU traffic to Redwood Private hosted in an EU region (we'll surface the compliance controls and KMS integrations). For the pilot review we'll include the gating checklist and timeline for a follow-on EU Private pilot.

Deliverables on the call: 
- 1-page pilot proposal (attached) — runs through scope, measurements, and pricing options.
- Benchmark plan (Jordan) and what NextWave needs to hand over.
- Onboarding timeline (Marissa) with CSM checkpoints.

After the call: Jordan will send the workload-run instructions and a short script to generate anonymized chat traffic; Priyom will publish the quantization baseline.

If anyone wants a quick sync pre-call (15 min) to walk the proposal, ping me and I'll set it up. Looking forward to the review.

Best,
Karthik

Attachments: nextwave-pilot-proposal.pdf, workload-sample-instructions.txt
